description: Render a slide to a PNG image preview for visual feedback.

deckId.description: Stable ID of the presentation deck

filePath.description: Optional PNG output path inside the managed workspace; .png is added or substituted

resolution.description: Optional output width in pixels; defaults to 1280

slideId.description: Stable ID of the slide to render

width.description: Legacy output width in pixels; resolution takes precedence

name: slide_render
